featuredPost.title: Breaking Into Product Design: Advice from Untitled Founder, Frankie
featuredPost.description: Let's get one thing out of the way: you don't need a fancy Bachelor's Degree to get into Product Design. We sat down with Frankie Sullivan to talk about gatekeeping in product design and how anyone can get into this growing industry.

content.subtitle: A Comprehensive Guide to Product Design Career

paragraphs.content: Product design has become one of the most sought-after careers in tech. This guide will walk you through the essential steps to break into this exciting field effectively.
Great design is not just about making things beautiful; it's about solving real problems for real people.
Start by building a strong portfolio that showcases your problem-solving skills and design thinking process. Focus on real projects and case studies that demonstrate your impact.

blogPosts.title: Building your API Stack
blogPosts.description: The rise of RESTful APIs has been met by a rise in tools for creating, testing, and managing them.

content.subtitle: Modern Tools and Best Practices for API Development

paragraphs.content: In today's interconnected world, APIs form the backbone of modern applications. Choosing the right tools and practices is crucial for building robust and maintainable APIs.
The quality of your API documentation is as important as the API itself.
From API design tools like Swagger to testing frameworks and monitoring solutions, we'll explore the essential components of a modern API development stack.

Facilitates integration between different services and platforms

blogPosts.title: Mastering React Hooks
blogPosts.description: A deep dive into React Hooks and how they can simplify your component logic.

content.subtitle: Understanding and Implementing React Hooks Effectively

paragraphs.content: React Hooks have transformed how we write React components. They allow you to use state and other React features without writing a class component.
Hooks let you split one component into smaller functions based on what pieces are related.
From useState and useEffect to creating custom hooks, we'll explore the most important patterns and best practices for modern React development.

highlights.title: Key Benefits
benefits: Simplifies component logic and reduces boilerplate code
Enables better code reuse through custom hooks
Improves testing and debugging experience

blogPosts.title: TypeScript Best Practices
blogPosts.description: Essential TypeScript patterns and practices for building robust applications.

paragraphs.content: TypeScript adds static typing to JavaScript, helping you catch errors early and write more maintainable code. Let's explore the best practices for leveraging TypeScript effectively.
TypeScript is not just about adding types; it's about writing better, more predictable code.
We'll cover advanced TypeScript features like generics, utility types, and how to structure large TypeScript projects for maximum maintainability.

highlights.title: Key Benefits
benefits: Catches errors at compile time rather than runtime
Improves code documentation and developer experience
Enables better refactoring and IDE support

blogPosts.description: Techniques and strategies for optimizing Node.js applications for better performance.

paragraphs.content: Node.js performance optimization is crucial for building scalable applications. This guide covers essential techniques for improving your Node.js application's performance.
Performance is not just about speed; it's about creating a better user experience.
From memory management and CPU optimization to database queries and caching strategies, we'll explore comprehensive approaches to Node.js performance tuning.

highlights.title: Key Benefits

Improves user experience with faster response times
Enables applications to handle higher traffic loads
